However, it fails to fully conform to the taxonomy because critical functional components (water cannon, pumping equipment) are either missing or structurally malformed (melted/amorphous). artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from moderate structural artifacts. The primary issue is the 'melting' of the bow water cannon, which lacks geometric rigidity. Secondary issues include soft boundaries between hull and superstructure and indistinct, fused railings. These are not catastrophic (the boat doesn't look like a blob), but they are clearly non-photorealistic and indicative of AI generation struggles with complex mechanical assemblies. The background distortion is minor. The severity is compounded by the fact that these artifacts affect the defining features of the class.
